text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Just a few days before the formal United Nations talks at Montreux, the Turkish side tries to poison the good climate by signing an accord for the partial integration of Turkish-held Cyprus with Turkey.

- The admission of a strongman of the Greek junta that he ordered the coup on the island in 1974 is not a new one. Phaedon Ghizikis's written confession has been on a shelf in parliament for the past nine years.
- A fifth British soldier has been charged with an assault on tourists in Ayia Napa.
- Turkey and the pseudo-state provoke with their agreement for "partial integration". Communist Akel condemns the move.
- On the eve of Montreux the Turks put the wheels in motion for integration. The all-party national council is due to discuss the development today.
- Turkey and the occupied areas sign a partial integration agreement for cooperation in financial and military fields.
